subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Is the current source evidence enough to sponsor a Feishu target-resolution repair now, or should maintainers require a current-main Feishu live repro with vendor diagnostics before adopting or replacing the linked PR?
rationale: The source path is suspicious but not conclusive: current code passes `receive_id_type`, the reporter's manual API call also failed, and the linked fix branch is conflicting and unproven.

options.title: Require current-main Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send log with vendor code/log_id before reviving or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Adopt the linked fork PR
options.body: Revive the conflicting fork only if maintainers accept the nullable target-resolution direction and require type fixes, regression tests, and real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement after proof
options.body: If fresh logs prove invalid target classification, close the fork and sponsor one focused Feishu resolver fix instead of preserving the stale branch.

recommendation.title: Require current-main Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send log with vendor code/log_id before reviving or replacing the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, so they are the best available owner for deciding Feishu ID semantics and proof needs.
